get.description: List the paths of the projects of the workspace.

schema.title: Response Projects Api V1 Projects Get

post.description: Create a project, with the folders of its pieces.

Create a piece (or a setup) of a project, with its content or from
its template; return its path.

schema.title: Response Create Piece Api V1 Pieces Post

get.description: Return a piece (or a setup) of a project: its options.

schema.title: Response Piece Api V1 Pieces  Path  Get

patch.description:
Rename a piece (or a setup) of a project, and the pieces and setups
that name it with it; return its new path.

schema.title: Response Rename Piece Api V1 Pieces  Path  Patch

put.description:
Write the content of a piece (or a setup) of a project: its options
that change (its comments stay).

delete.description:
Delete a piece (or a setup) of a project; the pieces and setups that
name it still do (see references), and its files of data stay.

get.description: Return a project: its pieces, setups and runs.

patch.description:
Move a project to another folder of the workspace; not while jobs of
it are queued or running.

delete.description:
Delete a project and all its files (its data and runs too); not while
jobs of it are queued or running.

get.description: Return the pieces and setups of a project that name one of its pieces.

schema.title: Response References Api V1 References  Path  Get

get.description: Return a folder: its folders and its files ('.': the workspace).

Describe a file of data from its headers, without reading its data:
each of its arrays, and what a dataset of it refuses or needs given;
velocity is the convention of velocities that its headers leave
ambiguous, rest the rest of its spectral axis (e.g. '6562.8
Angstrom'), which makes wavelengths or frequencies velocities, as a
dataset with that rest reads them, and spectral_type what a spectral
axis whose header gives a type FITS does not define is (e.g. 'AWAV';
see ArrayInfo).

schema.title: Response Describe Api V1 Describe  Path  Get

get.description:
Return the header of an array (an HDU) of a file of data, as it is in
the file (one header per HDU: the data and the errors of one file have
each their own).

Return a channel of a cube (an array of a file of data, in the
orientation of the model) as a frame of one array (ny, nx), with the
number of channels of the cube, the coordinate of the channel along
the spectral axis and its unit (null if unknown; see SpectrumView),
the range of the values of the cube for colours, and the least and
the greatest of its values (extent; null if it has none).

Return the spectrum of a pixel (x, y) of a cube, or its total spectrum
(the sum of its pixels in each channel): of all of them, or of a region
(x0 to x1, y0 to y1, inclusive).

Return the quick moment maps of a cube (NaN where they are not
defined) as a frame of arrays (ny, nx), named so, of the voxels of
the mask of its signal grown from seeds of signal-to-noise ratio snr
(0: of all of them; see Views.moments): measured as moments, its
flux, velocity, dispersion, skewness and kurtosis; or of a
Gauss-Hermite series fitted to each spectrum, its h3 and h4. Its
channels are read as a dataset of it reads them, of a rest, a
convention and a type, if given (see describe).

post.description:
Draw a PSF of the options of a piece of a project, on pixels of a
size or of its own scale, with the solid angle of its beam and its
width.

Draw an LSF of the options of a piece of a project, on channels of a
width or of its own scale, of velocities (at the rest of a line, if
given) or of a unit given, with its width.

Describe a galaxy of the options of a piece of a project, as the
library does without devices: the parameters it has, and its problems.

Render a galaxy of the options of a piece of a project at values of
its parameters, through an ideal observation (see Renders.galaxy): a
frame of its maps (ny, nx; named 'light', 'velocity', 'vx', 'vy',
'dispersion' and '{component}/{map}'; NaN where there is no light),
whose header has the size of the pixels (step, arcsec), the pixels
across (size), its curves (by name, with 'radius'; null where not
defined) and the problems of those that could not be drawn.

Render the cube of a galaxy (see Renders.cube), of its components that
emit lines, and keep it for the views of cubes (channel, spectrum and
moments) at the path returned.

Evaluate a galaxy through an observation of its project (see
Renders.observed), and keep its arrays (the model of each item, and
the data and errors of the observation, if it has them) for the views
of cubes (channel, spectrum and moments), each at the path returned.

get.description:
Return the JSON Schema of the configurations of GBKFIT, from the
options of the library (see gbkfit.schema): the forms of the pieces
are made of it.

schema.title: Response Config Schema Api V1 Schema Get

get.description:
Return the emission lines of the catalogue of GBKFIT, which emissions
name and a spectral axis of wavelengths or frequencies takes the rest
of (in vacuum or in air, as its type says).

schema.title: Response Catalogue Lines Api V1 Lines Get

get.description:
Return the traits that each type of component takes, by its type (see
gbkfit.model.components.TRAIT_TABLES): the types of its traits of each
kind, and the directions of its velocity and dispersion traits. (The
schema has every type of each kind, as the library reads them; a
component takes some of them.)

schema.title: Response Component Traits Api V1 Components Get

post.description:
Copy a file of data of the workspace into a project; return the path
of the copy (that of the same file if it has one).

schema.title: Response Import Data Api V1 Imports Post

post.description:
Write a file of data sent in the body (e.g. from the computer of the
page) into a project, by its name; return its path (that of the same
file if it has one).

schema.title: Response Upload Data Api V1 Uploads Post

get.description: Return the text of a file (e.g. a piece or a setup).

put.description: Write the text of a file, and its folders.

get.description:
Return a file as it is, of the type of its name (e.g. a figure, to
show in a page with the token in the query).

post.description:
Check the text of a file (e.g. as it is edited) as its task would:
a configuration itself, a piece of a project in the setups that name
it; and return its problems, by line.

get.description: Return a run: its manifest.

Return the data of a FITS file, or one plane of them (along their
first axis), as a frame of one array (float32).
List the jobs, oldest first.

schema.title: Response Jobs Api V1 Jobs Get

post.description: Queue a job, which starts when there is room.

get.description: Return a job.

post.description:
Stop a job: cancel it if queued, or interrupt it if running, as
Ctrl-C does (e.g. a fit ends with its best so far).

Keep the files of a preview of prep into the folder of its output_dir
(see JobRequest); the job then gives the files kept.

get.description:
Return how a file of data was prepared by a job of prep (see
PreparationInfo); null if it was not (e.g. a file imported as it is).

schema.title: Response Preparation Api V1 Preparations  Path  Get

delete.description:
Delete a file of data of a project (of its folder data), unless the
project names it (a piece, a setup or a run) or a job uses it.

get.description:
Return the preferences of the user (of the pages, e.g. the theme of
the Studio), and their file, in the folder of the user (~/.gbkfit),
the same for every folder served.

patch.description:
Set preferences of the user (a value of null removes one), keeping
the others; the clients are told (the event 'preferences').

get.description:
Follow the events of the server: 'job' (a job whose state changed),
'run' (the run of a job, when its manifest changed), 'progress' (a
report of the progress of a fit) and 'preferences' (the preferences
of the user, all of them, as they changed).

post.description:
Open a live session of a configuration: set it up once, to evaluate
it at the values of its free parameters (see evaluate).

get.description: Return a live session.

Return the name and version of the server, its API, and the pages
it serves.

ArrayInfo.title: ArrayInfo
ArrayInfo.description:
An array of a file of data (e.g. an HDU of a FITS file), from its
header: its index and name in the file, its shape and the types of
its axes, in the order of the model (x, y, then the spectral axis),
the unit of its values, the size of its pixels in that order (arcsec,
and km/s along a velocity axis; the spatial ones alone while its
spectral axis cannot be read, e.g. velocities of no convention or
wavelengths without a rest; none if its header has no coordinates on
the sky), the pixel (x, y; 0-based) that the model measures positions
on the sky from (its reference pixel; none without coordinates), its
beam (bmaj and bmin in arcsec, bpa in degrees; lists
for a beam of each channel), the noise of its values that its header
states (keyword RMS or NOISE), whether its header leaves it open
whether its velocities are radio or optical (a dataset of it gives
their convention), what a dataset of it refuses or needs given, and
what its values are as errors, if its header states it ('sigma',
'variance' or 'inverse_variance'; see gbkfit's HDUDescription.holds),
and the type its header gives a spectral axis that FITS does not
define (e.g. 'WAVELENGTH'; a dataset of it says what the axis is, see
gbkfit's HDUDescription.nonstandard_type), and the rest of its
spectral axis (e.g. '6562.8 Angstrom': its header's, RESTWAV or
RESTFRQ, or that given; none if none, or while the axis cannot be
read).

CatalogueLine.title: CatalogueLine
CatalogueLine.description:
An emission line of the catalogue of GBKFIT (see its LineCatalogue):
its name, its rest as text (e.g. '6564.61 Angstrom', in vacuum), and
as a number: its rest wavelength in vacuum (m) and in air (m; above
2000 Angstrom, where air wavelengths are used), or its rest frequency
(Hz), as the catalogue gives it.

CheckRequest.title: CheckRequest
CheckRequest.description: The text of a file to check (e.g. not saved yet), and its path.

CheckResult.title: CheckResult
CheckResult.description: The problems of a text (see the checker of the server).

ComponentTraits.title: ComponentTraits
ComponentTraits.description:
The traits a type of component takes (see TraitTable): the types of its
traits of each kind (e.g. 'vpt': ['uniform', 'arctan', ...]), and the
directions of its velocity and dispersion traits.

CubeRenderInfo.title: CubeRenderInfo
CubeRenderInfo.description:
The cube of a galaxy rendered (see Renders.cube): the path the views
of cubes take it at (its array 0; kept for a while, see Views.put), its
shape in the order of the model (nx, ny, nchannels), and the unit of
the coordinates of its channels (km/s).

Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic
Diagnostic.description: A problem of a text: its line (from 1), severity and message.

FileEntry.title: FileEntry
FileEntry.description: A file of a folder: its name, and its size (bytes).

FolderInfo.title: FolderInfo
FolderInfo.description:
A folder: its path, and its folders and files (but the hidden ones),
by name.

GalaxyInfo.title: GalaxyInfo
GalaxyInfo.description:
A galaxy as the library describes it (see Galaxies.describe): its
parameters ({name, title, desc, size, default, unit, range, period,
owner}, in its order) and its problems ({severity, path, message};
paths in the galaxy).

GalaxyRenderRequest.title: GalaxyRenderRequest
GalaxyRenderRequest.description:
A galaxy to render (see Renders.galaxy): the project of its piece, its
options (its files relative to the project), the values of its
parameters (numbers, or lists of them for vectors; the defaults for
those not given), how it is seen ('sky', 'face-on' or 'edge-on'), and
the pixels across.

GalaxyRequest.title: GalaxyRequest
GalaxyRequest.description:
A galaxy to describe: the project of its piece, and its options (its
files relative to the project).

HeaderInfo.title: HeaderInfo
HeaderInfo.description:
The header of an array (an HDU) of a file of data, as it is in the
file: its cards, as lines of text.

ImportRequest.title: ImportRequest
ImportRequest.description:
A file of data of the workspace to copy into a project: the project,
and the path of the file.

JobInfo.title: JobInfo
JobInfo.description:
A job: its id, task and options, whether it is a preview of prep not
kept, its state, its run, the files that a job of prep prepared (by
the options of their files, e.g. file_d; of moment maps, a list, one
for each map, None for a file not prepared; none for a preview
removed), when it was created, started and ended, the exit status
of its process, and the end of its log.

JobRequest.title: JobRequest
JobRequest.description:
A job to run: its task, and the options of the task (see
gbkfit.tasks), with their paths relative to the workspace. eval and
fit need a configuration ('config'), and write their run in the runs
of its setup, unless they give its folder ('output_dir'); resume
needs the folder of the run of the fit ('output_dir'); prep needs the
folder of the prepared files ('output_dir'), where they are kept as
imported files are (an identical file is reused; a name taken is
numbered), and how they were prepared is recorded (see
PreparationInfo). A job of prep can be a preview: its files stay
apart, to be looked at, until kept (POST /jobs/{id}/keep); previews
not kept are removed in time.

LSFRequest.title: LSFRequest
LSFRequest.description:
An LSF to draw: the project of its piece, its options (its files
relative to the project), the width of the channels (none: of its own
scale), the rest of the line it is drawn at (e.g. '6562.8 Angstrom';
widths in a unit of wavelength or frequency need it), the unit of the
channels: km/s (velocities) by default, or another, which draws it as
its widths give it (e.g. 'Angstrom', or 'pix': channels of the data;
without a rest), and the width of the channels of the data, which its
widths in pixels and its Hanning smoothing are of (none: those it is
drawn on).

LSFViewInfo.title: LSFViewInfo
LSFViewInfo.description:
An LSF drawn on channels (see Responses.lsf): its values (they sum
to 1), the width of the channels, its full width at half maximum (none
for a point), and the unit of both (e.g. 'km/s').

ObservedArrayInfo.title: ObservedArrayInfo
ObservedArrayInfo.description:
An array of a galaxy observed: its kind ('model', 'data' or 'error'),
its item (e.g. 'spectra', 'brightness', 'moment1'), the path the views of
cubes take it at (its array 0; a map, a cube of one channel; kept for a
while, see Views.put), its shape in the order of the model (nx, ny,
nchannels: 1 for a map), the unit of its values ('' if unknown), and
its pixels on the sky: their size (x, y; arcsec) and the pixel (x, y;
0-based) that the model measures positions from.

ObservedInfo.title: ObservedInfo
ObservedInfo.description:
A galaxy as an observation of its project sees it: the type of its
observable (e.g. 'pixel_spectra'), its arrays (the model of each item,
and the data and errors of the data, if it has them), and the warnings
of the library as it set them up.

ObservedRequest.title: ObservedRequest
ObservedRequest.description:
A galaxy to observe (see Renders.observed): the project of its piece,
its options and the values of its parameters (as a galaxy to render;
the defaults for those not given, also of the observation), and the
observation of the project that sees it, by name.

PSFRequest.title: PSFRequest

PSFViewInfo.title: PSFViewInfo
PSFViewInfo.description:
A PSF drawn on pixels (see Responses.psf): its values (rows of y,
from the bottom; they sum to 1), the size of the pixels (x, y;
arcsec), the solid angle of its beam (arcsec^2) and the full width at
half maximum of the circular Gaussian of that beam (arcsec; none for
a point), and its full widths at half maximum along its major and
minor axes (arcsec) and the position angle of its major axis
(degrees; none if round), as measured (none for a point).

PieceReference.title: PieceReference
PieceReference.description: A piece (or a setup) that names another: its folder and name.

PieceRename.title: PieceRename
PieceRename.description: The new name of a piece (a path in its folder, without .yaml).

PieceRequest.title: PieceRequest
PieceRequest.description:
A piece (or a setup) to create: its project, its folder (e.g.
galaxies, psfs or setups), its name (its path in the folder, without
.yaml), and its content (its options); by default, that of the
template of its folder.

PreferencesInfo.title: PreferencesInfo
PreferencesInfo.description:
The preferences of the user (of the pages, e.g. the theme of the
Studio): their values by name, and the file they are kept in, in
the folder of the user.

PreparationInfo.title: PreparationInfo
PreparationInfo.description:
How a file of data was prepared by a job of prep: the task, its
options (their files: a path, or {file, hdu}; of moment maps, lists),
the files it prepared (by the options of their files, as those of a
job), with their paths relative to the workspace, and when (ISO 8601,
UTC).

ProjectInfo.title: ProjectInfo
ProjectInfo.description:
A project: its path, the names of its pieces and setups by folder
(e.g. 'galaxies'), and the paths of its runs.

ProjectRename.title: ProjectRename
ProjectRename.description: The new folder of a project, in the workspace.

ProjectRequest.title: ProjectRequest
ProjectRequest.description: A project to create: its folder (its path).

ServerInfo.title: ServerInfo
ServerInfo.description:
The server: its name and version, the path of its API, and the names
of the pages it serves (at /<name>/).

SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo
SessionInfo.description:
A live session: its id, its configuration, its free parameters (by
element name), with their properties (e.g. their values, min and
max), and whether it has data (and so residuals and a chi-square).

SessionRequest.title: SessionRequest
SessionRequest.description: A live session to open: its configuration (its path).

SpectrumView.title: SpectrumView
SpectrumView.description:
The spectrum of a pixel of a cube: its values (none where it has
none), and the coordinates of its channels along its spectral axis
and their unit (km/s for velocities, GHz for frequencies, micron for
wavelengths; none if its header does not give them).
